request.raw_text: Change the shape of the profile of link arms to the shape of long hole to increase its stifness. Then change the diameter of the holes by 1mm and adjust the shape accordingly.

action_words: to the shape of long hole

areas_to_change.action: Replace the existing link-arm outer profiles with long-hole-shaped profiles.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: All blue scissor-link arms connecting the upper and lower red members.
areas_to_change.location: The crossing link arms on both sides of the assembly, including the material surrounding their end and central pivot holes.
areas_to_change.description: Reshape each arm into a continuous obround or capsule-like profile, with parallel sides and rounded ends comparable to the outline of an elongated hole. Adjust the local profile around each pivot to form a smooth, structurally continuous arm rather than separate-looking circular bosses and narrow connecting strips.

areas_to_change.action: Change the circular pivot-hole diameters by 1 mm and update the surrounding arm profile.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The circular holes in the link arms at the end pivots and central crossing pivots.
areas_to_change.location: All link-arm pin joints at the upper and lower attachment points and at the central scissor joints.
areas_to_change.description: Modify the applicable pivot-hole diameters by a total diametric amount of 1 mm. Resize the rounded ends and adjacent arm material as necessary to maintain concentricity, adequate edge distance, and the intended long-hole-shaped outer profile.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Upper and lower red rectangular members
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve their overall dimensions, spacing, thickness, and planar geometry.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Horizontal slots in the red members
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve slot size, shape, position, and slider travel unless a mating change is strictly required by the revised pin diameter.
Keep the end-hole and central-hole center positions unchanged so that link lengths, crossing geometry, alignment, and scissor kinematics remain unchanged.
Preserve their axes, coaxial relationships, assembly order, and freedom of rotation; resize mating pins only if the requested hole-diameter change requires it.
Preserve arm thickness, axial offsets, clearances, and stacking on both sides of the assembly unless profile adjustment is necessary to prevent interference.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: Each scissor link will have a smoother elongated-obround outer silhouette with rounded ends around its pivot holes. The pivot bores will have diameters altered by 1 mm, and the surrounding end radii or arm width will be adjusted consistently.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The linkage will retain its existing pivot locations and scissor motion while providing a more continuous arm section intended to improve stiffness and load distribution around the joints.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The assembly should open, close, pivot, and slide as before, with reduced local flexibility or stress concentration in the reshaped link arms, provided pin fit and inter-part clearances are maintained.

ambiguities.description: The direction of the 1 mm diameter change is not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Increase every applicable hole diameter by 1 mm.
Decrease every applicable hole diameter by 1 mm.
Change the diameter to 1 mm, although this is less likely than a 1 mm increment.

ambiguities.description: The request does not explicitly identify which link-arm holes are to be changed.
candidate_interpretations: Change all end and central pivot holes in every link arm.
Change only the end pivot holes.
Change only a selected subset of holes associated with the sliding joints.

ambiguities.description: The phrase 'profile of link arms to the shape of long hole' does not specify whether it refers to the external arm silhouette or a new internal cutout.
candidate_interpretations: Make the external silhouette of each arm obround or capsule-shaped.
Add an elongated through-slot inside each arm.
Blend the existing circular end bosses and straight arm body into one continuous obround-style external profile.

ambiguities.description: The amount and method of the accompanying profile adjustment are unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: Maintain the existing minimum radial wall thickness around each resized hole.
Maintain the existing overall arm width and only update the holes.
Scale the rounded arm ends with the changed hole diameter while keeping pivot centers and straight-section width fixed.
